d: Rashtrapti ne dan kie tash ke svarn puraskar, jharkhand ke lie gaurav ka pal, jamshedpur ko bhi mila sammana. vahin, nisha bhagat ke parijnon se milin rashtriy mahila aayog ki adhyaksh vijya rahatkar, parivar se mulakat kar vyakt ki sanvedna, mamle ki nishpaksh janch aur nyay dilane ka dilaya bharosa. bhagvan birsa munda ki 151vin jayanti ko lekar bhajpa ki or se das dinon tak honge vibhinn karyakram, 13 navanbar ko ulihatu se ranchi tak nikali jaegi padyatra, jabki 15 navanbar ko janjatiy gaurav divas ke avsar par honge vishesh aayojna. idhar, aaeeaaeeti aaeeesaem dhanbad men projekt sury…
